scientific_integrity: The square-root length formula is derived from the published source; the genus classification explicitly depends on the existing Farber–Schütz theorem plus the new interval-complete radical inequality analysis. No independence or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the five-active zero-mean relative-equilibrium family of the eight-site model is classified, for 0<t<1 outside two wall values. Floquet stability, attractors, and the singular-wall topology are not determined. The general planar polygon-space homology theorem is prior work and explicitly invoked. Priority against unlocated specialized literature remains provisional.
title: Two hidden topology transitions in the five-active zero-mean oscillator polygon
